gloss: taking care of one's health; temperance

definitions.gloss: taking care of one's health; leading a healthy lifestyle; temperance
definitions.explanation: Consciously maintaining healthy habits by moderating diet, exercise, sleep, and other lifestyle factors. Implies self-discipline and restraint in daily living.

examples.japanese: {摂生|せっせい}を{心|こころ}がけている。
examples.english: I make a point of taking care of my health.

examples.japanese: {不摂生|ふせっせい}な{生活|せいかつ}を{続|つづ}けると{体|からだ}を{壊|こわ}す。
examples.english: If you keep living an unhealthy lifestyle, you'll ruin your health.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}に{摂生|せっせい}するよう{言|い}われ、お{酒|さけ}と{甘|あま}い{物|もの}を{控|ひか}えている。
examples.english: My doctor told me to take better care of my health, so I've been cutting back on alcohol and sweets.

notes:
USAGE:
{摂生|せっせい} emphasizes maintaining health through moderation and self-care. The negative form {不摂生|ふせっせい} (unhealthy living, lack of self-care) is perhaps even more commonly encountered.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {摂生|せっせい}する (to take care of one's health)
- {不摂生|ふせっせい} (unhealthy habits, lack of self-care)
- {摂生|せっせい}を{心|こころ}がける (to make an effort to live healthily)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{節制|せっせい} (also read せっせい) means moderation or self-restraint, with more emphasis on cutting back on excess. {養生|ようじょう} means recuperation or convalescence, focusing on recovering health.
